settings.label: USB KEYBOARD
settings.help: Plays the OP-1 from a USB MIDI keyboard plugged in through a mini-USB OTG adapter. Off leaves the USB port as stock.

settings.label: KNOB MAP
settings.help: Your controller's knobs turn the OP-1's four encoders: the first four learned on page 1, the next four on page 2.

settings.label: LEARN KNOBS
settings.help: Turn on, then turn each knob a little: top row left to right, then the bottom row. Goes off by itself after eight.
